messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the person's entire outfit with the complete outfit shown in the reference images, using the first reference for the front view and the second reference for the back view. The target outfit consists of the top, the bottoms, and the footwear. Remove any original clothing or footwear that is not part of this target outfit. Keep all non-clothing attributes unchanged.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please replace the person's entire outfit with the complete outfit shown from the front and back in the reference images, consisting of the top, the bottoms, and the footwear. Remove any original clothing or footwear that is not part of this target outfit. Keep all non-clothing attributes unchanged. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands with her back to the camera, raises one hand to her head, then turns to a side profile while keeping a hand near her hair.","camera":"A static, low-angle full-body shot from behind the character.","clothing":"A black sleeveless top with a gray patterned back panel and a black belt, paired with loose white trousers and dark shoes.","hair_color":"White.","hairstyle":"Short, spiky hair that is later gathered into a small ponytail.","identity":"A slender 3D-rendered female character with pale skin, shown mostly from behind and in profile.","scene":"An outdoor amusement park at dusk, with a red swing ride on the left and a lit carousel structure on the right under a pink and blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The blue patterned dress and red shoes were replaced with a black sleeveless top featuring a gray patterned back panel and black belt, loose white trousers, and dark shoes. The character's hair, body, pose, camera, and amusement-park scene remain largely consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the character's entire outfit with the reference outfit: patterned sleeveless top, loose white trousers, and matching footwear, removing the original dress and red shoes while preserving non-clothing attributes.
uncertain: Exact footwear match to the reference is difficult to confirm from the video's distance and angle.
unexpected_changes: The top appears mostly black in side/front views, while the reference front view shows a more visible gray pattern across the torso.
